name: Exa
summary: Exa builds a web-search API for AI applications, combining search, retrieval, and web-content tools for developers and agents.
overview: Exa is an AI search company building APIs for applications and agents that need web-scale retrieval, search, and content extraction.

facts.label: Latest financing
facts.note: The search company announced the round led by Andreessen Horowitz.

bull_case: As AI agents take on more research and decision tasks, demand for high-quality retrieval can make search infrastructure an important layer of the AI stack.
bear_case: Exa competes with hyperscalers, traditional search providers, and other API vendors; sustaining quality while managing crawling and compute costs is difficult.
directory_notes: Public financing and operating data remain limited.

intelligence.description: Exa provides search and retrieval infrastructure for AI applications and agents.
company: Exa builds a web-search API designed for AI applications and agents. Its products combine search, retrieval, and content extraction so developers can give AI systems access to current web information.
In May 2026, Exa announced a $250 million Series C led by Andreessen Horowitz at a $2.2 billion valuation. The company said its tools were used by more than 400,000 developers.
intelligence.why_it_matters: Exa is a useful indicator of whether AI search becomes a distinct infrastructure market rather than a feature absorbed by model providers or incumbent search engines.

changed.text: Profile reviewed against available public information.

takeaways: Exa is building a web-search and retrieval layer for AI products.
Its May 2026 Series C raised $250 million at a $2.2 billion valuation.
The company reports more than 400,000 developers using its products.
Search quality, cost, and durable API adoption are the key variables to watch.
